Primary request: jagged brown stone spears physically erupting from cracked dark earth, ochre sediment, chunks hurled upward, low dust cloud; no falling meteor. Frames show anticipation, growth, peak impact, follow-through, dispersion and fading fragments in order. Strict uniform grid: each frame fits in its own cell with at least 12% completely transparent margin on all sides, same center in every cell, no overlap between neighboring cells. No scene, no character, no monsters, no text, no labels, no borders, no opaque background. Crisp polished pixel clusters, readable silhouette at small game scale, high contrast luminous core, transparent negative space. Do not draw a simple tinted generic explosion. This must visually read specifically as earth attack.
